title: shub-smale-tau9: Hardened Exhaustive Certification of z_max(9) = 6, Lean 4 Soundness Formalization, and Record Finite-tau Witnesses for the Shub-Smale tau-Conjecture
description: Hardened exact-CRT exhaustive certification of z_max(9) = 6 over all of Z for constant-free straight-line programs (Shub-Smale tau-conjecture / Smale's 4th Problem), extending Santibanez-Leal (2026). Includes an independent naive Rust enumerator (tau <= 7), mutation/canary audit suite, dual exact Z[x] verifiers (pure Python + python-flint), record witnesses up to tau = 18, and a zero-sorry Lean 4.36.0 formalization (8 modules, 4,228 LOC, 204 theorems/lemmas) proving the soundness of all canonicalization, dead-gate pruning, and per-leaf certification rules. AI provenance disclosure: developed with AI assistance (Antigravity Harness + Gemini 4 Neon) and audited via independent adversarial reimplementation and Lean 4 kernel checks.
